There's no fixed limit on how many sites you can create in one Wix account. You can create as many as you need, for example for different businesses, a personal blog, or design experiments.

A few things to know:
- **Free sites:** if you reach the limit of free sites in your account, you can move old sites to the Trash or upgrade sites to Premium.
- **Premium plans cover one site each.** To use Premium features on a second site, you need a second Premium plan.
- You can view and manage all your sites from the **Sites** page in your account.

You can add a custom text field to the product so customers can type the name they want on the shirt:

1. Go to **Products** in your site's dashboard.
2. Select the shirt (or click **New Product**).
3. Scroll down and click **Add Custom Text Field**.
4. Enter a title, e.g. *What name should we print?*
5. Set the character limit.
6. Tick **Mandatory field** if customers must fill it in.
7. Click **Save**.

You can add up to 2 custom text fields per product. After an order is placed, you'll see what the customer entered in the **Orders** tab.

Premium plans come with a **14-day money-back guarantee** for new plan purchases:

- **Within 14 days of buying a new plan:** cancel the plan and you're refunded automatically to your payment method. No request is needed. Refunds can take up to 20 business days to appear, and the plan is deactivated immediately.
- **After 14 days:** canceling turns off automatic renewal, and the plan stays active until its expiration date. Your site then returns to the free version (it isn't deleted).
- **Not covered:** refunds for plan renewals or upgrades of an existing plan.

If you're outside these rules but believe you deserve a refund, you can contact support to have your request reviewed.

Yes. The free 1-year domain voucher is issued **with** the initial purchase of a selected yearly (or multi-year) plan, so it won't appear until after you've bought the plan.

Once you've purchased the plan:
1. Find the voucher in the **Premium Vouchers** section of your account.
2. Go to **Domains** and click **Buy a Domain** (or **Get a New Domain**).
3. Search for your domain and click **Get It**.
4. Choose a registration period and check that the voucher is applied in the summary.
5. Complete checkout. You'll enter payment details for next year's renewal, but you won't be charged now.

Note: the voucher must be redeemed within 2 months (60 days) of buying the plan, and only for a new domain.

First, try opening your browser in incognito/private mode. If the problem goes away there, it's cache-related. To clear the cache, close all browser windows and tabs, open a new tab (without Wix open), then:

- **Chrome:** press Ctrl+Shift+Del (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac), set Time range to **All time**, tick **Cached images and files**, click **Clear data**.
- **Firefox:** press Ctrl+Shift+Del (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac), choose **Everything**, tick **Cache**, click **Clear now**.
- **Safari:** press Cmd+, → **Advanced** → tick **Show Develop menu**, then **Develop → Empty Caches**.
- **Edge:** press Ctrl+Shift+Del (Cmd+Shift+Delete on Mac), tick **Cached data and files**, click **Clear**.

Then close and reopen the browser. If issues continue, try flushing your system's DNS.

To unpublish your site from the Wix Editor:

1. Open your site in the Wix Editor.
2. Select **Site** in the top toolbar.
3. Click **Unpublish Site**.
4. Select **Unpublish** in the dashboard window.
5. Click **Unpublish** in the pop-up to confirm.

Good to know:
- Unpublishing doesn't cancel your domain or Premium plan.
- You can republish anytime by clicking **Publish** in the editor.
- It's only possible on desktop, and it applies to the whole site (not single pages).
- If the site stays unpublished for more than a few days, your SEO ranking may be affected.

When you paste elements that contain media into another site, you should be asked to either **Upload** (copy the files into the target site's Media Manager) or **Don't Upload**. Choose **Upload** so the images come across.

If you don't get that option, the likely reason is the gallery type: **Wix Pro Gallery can't be copied** between sites. In that case you'll need to add the gallery on the new site and add the images there.

Also check:
- Both sites must be in the Wix Editor and open in the **same browser**.
- If copying doesn't work at all, your browser's local storage may be full. Clearing local storage usually fixes it.

If you've checked these and the images still won't transfer, I can connect you with a support agent.

You can block off time for a single staff member in your Bookings calendar:

1. Go to **Booking Calendar** in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **Add**, or click the time slot you want to block.
3. Select **Blocked Time**.
4. Choose the staff member from the **Staff** drop-down.
5. (Optional) Add a title, e.g. *Vacation*.
6. Select the start and end date and time.
7. Click **Block**.

Customers won't be able to book new appointments with that staff member during the blocked time. Note that it doesn't override existing appointments or scheduled class/course sessions.

response:
With Google Ads with Wix, billing works like this:

- **Monthly subscription:** you pay one subscription for all your campaigns. It's added to your **ad credit** each month.
- **Wix fee:** Wix keeps 15% of your payment for running and optimizing campaigns; the other 85% goes to ad credit spent on clicks.
- **Daily spend:** each campaign's daily spend comes out of your total ad credit. Google charges per click, so unused spend rolls over to the next month.
- **One-time top-ups:** go to **Manage Spend & Credits → Manage Ad Credits → Purchase one-time ad credits**.
- **Invoices:** see **Billing History** in your account. Prices exclude VAT, which depends on your billing country.
- **Currency:** USD, EUR, GBP and JPY are used directly; other currencies are converted to USD ad credits.
